description: This file contains inline functions and API implementations for a linked list data structure, including list initialization, insertion, removal, iteration, and low-level node operations.

methods.name: __ds_list_init
methods.description: Initializes a linked list with a specified configuration.

methods.name: ds_list_node_insert_after
methods.description: Inserts a node after a specified node in the list.

methods.name: ds_list_node_remove_after
methods.description: Removes the node following a specified node.

methods.name: ds_list_node_next
methods.description: Returns the next node in the list.

methods.name: ds_list_node_insert_head
methods.description: Inserts a node at the head of the list.

methods.name: ds_list_node_insert_tail
methods.description: Inserts a node at the tail of the list.
